title: Research
text:
My research combines computational geodynamics, geophysics, and scientific computing to understand Earth processes through numerical modelling and data-informed interpretation.


I work on numerical models of tectonic and mantle processes, with emphasis on subduction-zone dynamics, tectonic coupling, lithospheric deformation, and long-term loading along active margins. My PhD research investigated tectonic coupling and loading along the Sunda margin through three-dimensional regional numerical modelling.



My work connects geodynamic models with megathrust seismicity, subduction-interface mechanics, and tectonic loading. I am interested in how far-field forcing, slab geometry, rheology, and regional structure influence deformation and seismic hazard-relevant processes.



My background includes gravity and geoid modelling, seismic processing and imaging, GIS, and geophysical data acquisition and interpretation. This observational foundation supports model design, validation, and interpretation.



Benchmarking is central to reproducible geodynamics. Current interests include annulus and spherical-shell Stokes benchmarks, Taylor-Hood finite elements, curved-domain modelling, boundary diagnostics, convergence studies, and PETSc/MPI performance checks.



I contribute to scientific software for geodynamics, including development and verification of the Underworld codebase. This includes core features, user-facing APIs, documentation, training materials, debugging, and reproducible workflows for desktop, HPC, and cloud environments.

title: Software
text:
I work on the Underworld geodynamics codebase as an open-source developer, contributing to core features, user-facing interfaces, testing, debugging, documentation, and training for the geodynamics community.
Underworld3 is a Python-based geodynamics modelling framework built around PETSc, symbolic problem specification, and modern finite-element workflows.

Underworld3 upstream: https://github.com/underworldcode/underworld3
GitHub profile: https://github.com/gthyagi






Repository: https://github.com/gthyagi/UW3_Annulus_Spherical_Benchmarks
This work supports reproducible verification and benchmarking of geodynamic modelling workflows, including:

Annulus and spherical-shell Stokes-flow benchmarks
Taylor-Hood finite elements
Curved-domain and spherical geometry problems
Penalty and Nitsche-style free-slip boundary conditions
Boundary diagnostics and convergence checks
HPC scaling and PETSc timing diagnostics

title: Thyagarajulu Gollapalli
text:
I am a Research Officer and Software Engineer at the Australian National University, working across computational geodynamics, geophysics, numerical modelling, high-performance computing, and open-source research software.
My current work focuses on the Underworld geodynamics codebase, with interests in finite-element modelling, subduction-zone dynamics, megathrust seismicity, geophysical data interpretation, and reproducible scientific computing.

title: Thyagarajulu Gollapalli
text:
Research Interests


Computational geodynamics
Numerical models of mantle and lithosphere dynamics, including Stokes-flow systems, subduction margins, tectonic loading, and benchmark problems.


Geophysics and Earth systems
Gravity, geoid, seismic imaging, geophysical interpretation, GIS, and links between observations and process-based models.


Research software
Development, testing, documentation, and training for open-source geodynamics tools, especially Underworld and Python-based modelling workflows.

title: Thyagarajulu Gollapalli
text:
Featured Work

Underworld3 development: open-source development for geodynamics modelling, user-facing interfaces, testing, debugging, documentation, and training.
Megathrust and subduction dynamics: numerical modelling of tectonic coupling and loading along active convergent margins, including the Sunda margin.
Benchmarking and reproducibility: finite-element benchmarks, PETSc-based workflows, HPC diagnostics, and reproducible scientific computing.
